items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: But he already had Johnny Russell, a great tenor player here.

ctx.x: I can remember Bud Johnson coming into Chicago out of Kansas City. (Inaudible) in Chicago.

Bud and Keg and I, we lived in Mrs. Potter's rooming house on South Parkway. We were almost like brothers. I was one of the Johnson Brothers for a long time. Because Keg and I came to New York together with Benny Carter. And we were so disappointed because Benny didn't bring Bud. But he already had Johnny Russell, a great tenor player here.
That's right. A great tenor player. Ben Webster liked him a lot, too.
